Element.attribute: Functional requirements describe capabilities the system will be able to perform in terms of behaviors or operations - specific information, application actions, or responses. Functional Requirements specify what the solution or product must do, and they must be specified in a way that is independent of the technology that will be used to implement the solution. This approach allows the logical essence of the requirement to be abstracted in a way that enables alternate technical implementation options to be evaluated later during design without technological bias obfuscating or substituting for the real requirement.
To formally capture and describe the capabilities that must be supported by the system, independent of the technology.
